en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural monastery complex nestled in a hilly, wooded landscape. The main building is a two‑storey structure with tiled roof and several windows, adjacent to a small church with arches and a square belfry or tower. Dense trees and shrubs surround the buildings. Greek text is printed vertically along the right side, and the website address 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower part of the image.
